thread:
marta: quick cross-team sync — one-line updates on v2 migration ownership and blockers pls. I want to lock owners for SDKs, infra cutover, and the deprec date by EOD.
Alex: i can own the node/python SDK bumps. PRs are open but need review for the auth header change. pinging @sam for runtime deps. :hand:
Sam: looking now — runtime has one blocking change: token propagation in the proxy. I'll have a mitigation flag by tomorrow AM.
Nina: i'll take mobile SDKs (iOS + Android). timeline: feature branch -> canary -> full rollout. aiming for canary weds 5pm PST (5% traffic).
Liam: infra note — the dedicated pool GPU allocator needs a small change for the new kv-cache header. Risk: short spike during canary ramp if allocator hits fragmentation. Mitigation: reserve a 10% buffer and enable soft-preemption.
marta: thanks. @alex can you drop the SDK PR links here and add a short changelog entry? we need docs + SDKs by canary.
Alex: sure. PRs: https://git.redwood.dev/sdk/node/pull/418 and https://git.redwood.dev/sdk/python/pull/302 — changelog snippet below:
```
- bump: v2 endpoint support
- auth: prefer `x-rdwd-api-key` over legacy header
- compatibility: fallback to v1 route when `x-rdwd-compat` is present
```
Sam: noted about the proxy flag. i'll add `--v2-compat` gated behind `FF_V2_COMPAT` and wire it to rollout service. will post the deploy playbook shortly.
Nina: can we coordinate mobile canary cohorts? need a list of test accounts + region routing. cc @liam for infra routing rules.
Liam: yep — i'll add a route tag `canary.v2` and ensure it only goes to the reserved pool. also will add an alert for allocator fragmentation > 70%.
Alex: small ask — can reviewers prioritize the node SDK auth change? it's blocking webhooks for a couple of customers.
Sam: i'll schedule a quick review slot after lunch and push the proxy flag change to staging.
marta: ok ownership summary so far: SDKs (alex + nina), runtime/proxy (sam), infra routing/allocator (liam), rollout coordination (marta). if anyone wants to swap, speak now.
Nina: confirmed. i'll own rollout coordination for mobile slice.
Alex: confirmed for Node/Python SDKs.
Sam: confirmed. pushing staging today.
Liam: confirmed. will create the allocator runbook and alerts.
deploy-bot: [deploy] staging:v2-compat-proxy deployed at 2026-03-17T15:23:00Z — check smoke tests.
marta: last bit — deprecation date proposal: announce next Tues, deprec date in 60 days. objections?
Alex: sounds reasonable. need to sync docs team for the announcement copy.
Nina: ok from mobile side.
Sam: fine, but can we add a rollback window plan in case of perf regressions?
Liam: yes — I'll publish rollback playbook and make the reserved pool pre-warmed for fast fallback.
marta: perfect. i'll update the migration board and tag owners. linking board: https://boards.redwood.dev/migration/board/142
Alex: i'll add SDK checklist and PR owners there.
Sam: will attach proxy smoke test logs once staging run completes.
Nina: adding mobile canary cohort + test accounts to the board.
marta: thanks team — i'll circle back EOD with a summary. :thumbsup:
